{{Top|leg}}
'''Combat cloud cars''' were combination combat and patrol craft which filled a gap between traditional [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. They had a maximum altitude of 100 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].<ref name="Vehicles and Vessels">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

==Overview==
While built like traditional [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]], with linked [[Ion engine/Legends|ion]]/[[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engines and sealed cabin for high-altitude flight, they had superior speed and maneuverability and could operate up to altitudes of around one hundred kilometers. They sported extra hull plating and enhanced weaponry which allowed them to stand up to space-capable fighters while operating at a fraction of the cost. The use of standardized replacement also made them more mechanically reliable than airspeeders which had been modified for combat, with far less time spent on maintenance, and thanks to their ion engines combat cloud cars could operate in environments hazardous to repulsorlift-only vehicles.<ref name="ESVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Besides combat missions these aircraft were used in more civilian roles such as customs enforcement and even traffic control. Among the many prominent vehicle manufacturers who produced combat cloud cars were [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]], [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech]], [[Mekuun Corporation/Legends|Merkuun]], [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] and [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian]], which produced the [[Talon I combat cloud car]].<ref name="ESVV" />
